o.A: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE category id IN (SELECT category_id FROM products WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM orders GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT() > 10));
o.B: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM orders WHERE COUNT() == 10);
o.C: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM products INNER JOIN orders ON products.product_id = orders.product_id WHERE COUNT() < 10);
o.D: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM products INNER JOIN orders ON products.product_id = orders.product_id GROUP BY category_id HAVING COUNT() > 10);
o.E: SELECT * FROM categories, category_id IN (SELECT category id FROM products WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM orders GROUP BY product_id) AND COUNT() > 10);
o.F: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM orders GROUP BY category_id HAVING COUNT() = 10);
